description: Source code for Atheros AR71xx built-in Ethernet MAC driver, including initialization, ring buffer management, PHY configuration, and register access functions.

methods.name: ag71xx_ring_alloc
methods.description: Allocates and initializes ring buffer for Ethernet descriptors.

methods.name: ag71xx_rings_init
methods.description: Initializes both transmit and receive rings.

methods.name: ag71xx_hw_set_macaddr
methods.description: Sets MAC address in hardware registers.

methods.name: ag71xx_dma_reset
methods.description: Resets DMA engine and clears status.

methods.name: ag71xx_speed_str
methods.description: Returns string representation of current speed.

methods.name: ag71xx_link_adjust
methods.description: Adjusts link parameters based on PHY status.

methods.name: ag71xx_getMiiSpeed
methods.description: Reads PHY registers to determine link speed and duplex.

methods.name: ag71xx_hw_start
methods.description: Initializes hardware and starts Ethernet interface.

methods.name: ag71xx_register
methods.description: Registers Ethernet interfaces based on configuration.
